FILE: app/notes/pointer-lock.json
```json
{ "lockedNoButton": false, "lockedButtonHeld": true, "rightDrag": false, "touchDrag": true }
```

I wrote the JSON based on the standard Babylon free-camera behavior: left-button/touch drags rotate, right-button drags pan, and pointer-lock movement without a button held is not treated as rotation. I was not able to verify this from the `.d.ts` alone, since type declarations don’t encode the runtime pointer handling.
